Turtle Strike Voiceover

Turtle Strike. A great App. Fantastic graphics on this game. I got to voice it in my Movie Trailer Voice.

The movie trailer voice

As you can tell by my blog, I like to voice game trailers. I feel very lucky to work with some amazing production houses who create these videos. This one needed that all-American movie trailer voiceover style and I had a lot of fun with it. Essentially, the style for this was the classic in-a-world voice and it's something I rarely get to say. If you'd like to hear more of my game trailers, check out my Warwings and Worms WMD trailers.

What is Turtle Strike?

Turtle Strike is a free-to-play multiplayer strategy game with live turn-based mechanics developed by the Prague-based eeGon Games. Both players have limited time to plan their moves and then the moves of both players are processed simultaneously.
This game clearly has a lot of humour packed into it, and this humour definitely made its way onto the trailer script. It's always easier for me when the script is well written!
